name: Vic de Vitaminevreter
summary: Step into the colorful world of Vic, a cheerful little creature with an insatiable hunger for vitamins! In this exciting and educational platform game, you’ll travel through various worlds — from the Vegetable Forest to the Fruittopia Island — in search of healthy snacks and hidden superfoods. But watch out: cotton candy spiders, fat monsters, and soda snakes are lurking around!
